# Pixel Library Desk

A small offline browser app that simulates a library desk with a list of 6 built-in books.

## Features

- Shows 6 books, each with a title and status (Available or Checked out).
- Buttons to check out or return each book.
- A filter checkbox to show only available books.
- A live count of checked-out books.
- Fully keyboard-accessible with labeled controls and visible focus states.
- Responsive layout that works from 360px wide.

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure
- `style.css` – styling
- `script.js` – logic
